description.value: Tiki Shores Inn & Suites is a 120+-room lakeside resort property situated directly across the street from Okanagan Beach in Penticton, offering spacious suites with full kitchens ranging from studios to penthouses. The See & Do page explicitly highlights the nearby Kettle Valley Trail (Trans-Canada Trail) and City of Penticton Trails Network, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan. On-site amenities include a heated outdoor pool, BBQ areas, an on-site restaurant, and a guest laundromat.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and detailed, confirming the property is open and operating as a suite-style inn. The front page and about page list amenities explicitly, including 'The on-site guest laundromat' and 'Wireless high-speed Internet service,' supporting those amenity values. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, e-bike charging, tools, or pump anywhere in the site content, so those remain null. The OSM name ('Tiki Shores Motel') conflicts with the website's consistent branding ('Tiki Shores Inn & Suites'), and the address omits 'West' on the website contact page.
concerns: OSM name is 'Tiki Shores Motel' but the website consistently brands the property as 'Tiki Shores Inn & Suites' across all pages.
OSM address lists '914 West Lakeshore Drive' but the website contact page shows '914 Lakeshore Drive' (omitting 'West'); used website value as it is the business's own current contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible accommodation in Penticton with a functioning website, booking capability, and a location directly cited near major cycling routes including the Kettle Valley Trail.

Laundry.detail: Website front page and amenities list state 'The on-site guest laundromat.'

Nearby evening food.detail: About page states 'Along the Lakeshore stretch, there are fire pits, vendors, parks and restaurants'; property also has an on-site restaurant

wow_evidence: See & Do page explicitly highlights the nearby Kettle Valley Trail (Trans-Canada Trail)
